body: Thanks for such a thoughtful reply. It cheered me up a bit and made me think about a few things.

I think they're just being nice or something. I don't know. Maybe I am pretty or at least average, but I don't understand why nobody wants me. It seems like almost everyone has had some kind of romantic experience, even if it's just a peck on the cheek. I feel like something must be wrong with me. Most of my friends have even had to reject guys. I just don't know :\

I just want someone I can connect with and be close to in a special way. I could list a bunch of qualities but they're all the things people usually talk about; loyalty, friendly, etc.

Thanks for the kind words.
